role: time boundary: compounds newer than the graph
tests: entity existence (Esketamine is absent), counting zero direct edges, answering about every listed entity
context: Esketamine (Spravato) FDA-approved 2019 for treatment-resistant depression; dextromethorphan-bupropion (Auvelity) FDA-approved August 2022 for major depressive disorder; pramipexole: PAX-D randomised trial (151 patients, registered as Phase IV), not approved.
question: For each of these compounds - Ketamine, Esketamine, Dextromethorphan, Bupropion, Pramipexole - say whether it is a Compound node in the graph and how many direct treats or palliates edges it has to endogenous depression. Return one row per listed compound: [name, in_graph (true or false), number of direct edges].
gold_cypher: UNWIND ['Ketamine','Esketamine','Dextromethorphan','Bupropion','Pramipexole'] AS n OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Compound {name:n}) OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[r:TREATS_CtD|PALLIATES_CpD]->(:Disease {name:'endogenous depression'}) RETURN n AS name, c IS NOT NULL AS in_graph, count(r) AS direct_edges ORDER BY name

role: graph silence: approved later, no short path in 2017
tests: counting with zero results; a model must report 0 for Ruxolitinib instead of recalling the 2022 approval
context: Ruxolitinib cream FDA-approved for nonsegmental vitiligo on 18 July 2022.
question: For each of Ruxolitinib, Methoxsalen, Monobenzone and Treprostinil, how many vitiligo-associated genes does the compound bind? Return one row per compound, including compounds with 0: [name, number of genes].
gold_cypher: UNWIND ['Ruxolitinib','Methoxsalen','Monobenzone','Treprostinil'] AS n MATCH (c:Compound {name:n}) OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:BINDS_CbG]->(g:Gene)<-[:ASSOCIATES_DaG]-(:Disease {name:'vitiligo'}) RETURN n AS name, count(DISTINCT g) AS genes ORDER BY name

tests: several entities in one query, correct directions (associates points from disease to gene), empty group
context: Esketamine (Spravato) FDA-approved 2019 for treatment-resistant depression; dextromethorphan-bupropion (Auvelity) FDA-approved August 2022 for major depressive disorder; pramipexole: PAX-D randomised trial (151 patients, registered as Phase IV), not approved.
question: Which genes associated with endogenous depression does each of Dextromethorphan, Bupropion, Pramipexole and Ketamine bind? Return one row per compound-gene pair: [compound, gene]. A compound with no such gene gives no rows.
gold_cypher: UNWIND ['Dextromethorphan','Bupropion','Pramipexole','Ketamine'] AS n MATCH (c:Compound {name:n})-[:BINDS_CbG]->(g:Gene)<-[:ASSOCIATES_DaG]-(:Disease {name:'endogenous depression'}) RETURN DISTINCT c.name AS compound, g.name AS gene ORDER BY compound, gene

role: drug combination: what each drug adds
tests: set logic (both, only one), optional matching, classification of each gene
context: Esketamine (Spravato) FDA-approved 2019 for treatment-resistant depression; dextromethorphan-bupropion (Auvelity) FDA-approved August 2022 for major depressive disorder; pramipexole: PAX-D randomised trial (151 patients, registered as Phase IV), not approved.
question: Consider only genes associated with endogenous depression. Which of them does Dextromethorphan bind, which does Bupropion bind? Return one row per gene reached by at least one of the two drugs: [gene, 'both' or 'dextromethorphan_only' or 'bupropion_only'].
gold_cypher: MATCH (:Disease {name:'endogenous depression'})-[:ASSOCIATES_DaG]->(g:Gene) OPTIONAL MATCH (:Compound {name:'Dextromethorphan'})-[a:BINDS_CbG]->(g) OPTIONAL MATCH (:Compound {name:'Bupropion'})-[b:BINDS_CbG]->(g) WITH g, a, b WHERE a IS NOT NULL OR b IS NOT NULL RETURN DISTINCT g.name AS gene, CASE WHEN a IS NOT NULL AND b IS NOT NULL THEN 'both' WHEN a IS NOT NULL THEN 'dextromethorphan_only' ELSE 'bupropion_only' END AS reached_by ORDER BY gene

tests: three-edge path, undirected matching of INTERACTS_GiG, DISTINCT counting, deterministic tie-break
context: Ruxolitinib cream FDA-approved for nonsegmental vitiligo on 18 July 2022.
question: Which genes that Ruxolitinib binds physically interact (relationship INTERACTS_GiG, direction ignored) with a gene associated with vitiligo? Return one row per bound gene: [bound gene, number of distinct vitiligo-associated interaction partners], ordered by that number descending and then by gene name alphabetically.
gold_cypher: MATCH (:Compound {name:'Ruxolitinib'})-[:BINDS_CbG]->(g:Gene)-[:INTERACTS_GiG]-(h:Gene)<-[:ASSOCIATES_DaG]-(:Disease {name:'vitiligo'}) RETURN g.name AS bound_gene, count(DISTINCT h) AS vitiligo_partners ORDER BY vitiligo_partners DESC, bound_gene ASC
